title: 30A Coastal Canopy
meta_description: Just 2 blocks to the beach, 30A Coastal Canopy is a stunning 5BDR home boasting a rooftop patio, ocean views, and community pool access.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Indulge in the love for the Gulf of Mexico at this exquisite 30a beach retreat nestled in Twin Palms. Welcome to "Coastal Canopy," a newly crafted five-bedroom, four-bathroom luxury home that brings you so close to the beach, you can feel the gentle waves while lounging on the rooftop terrace. Imagine grilling your favorite dishes as you take in breathtaking views of the 30A area. This coastal sanctuary radiates with comfort, offering everything needed for a blissful beach vacation. From the plush furnishings to the rooftop ambiance, Coastal Canopy ensures a relaxing getaway. Conveniently located, it's just a short journey to 30A Avenue for all your shopping and dining desires. Your only dilemma during this vacation will be choosing between unwinding on the rooftop terrace, enjoying entertainment in the living room, or strolling along the pristine white sand beaches to witness a mesmerizing sunset. All these experiences await you in this idyllic coastal abode.

ABOUT THE AREA: Next door to the famous "Donut Hole", The Destin Ice Market, The Crossings at Inlet Beach, and 30Avenue Shops with 7+ restaurants, boutiques, and a yoga studio all within a 5-minute walk. There is a walkable tunnel to the beach. Walk or ride bikes to neighboring Rosemary, Seacrest, or Alys Beaches for nightly entertainment.

BEACH ACCESS: Inlet Beach is one of 30A's best beaches where you have space to spread out as well as important amenities like parking, bathrooms \& showers. It's also easy access via a ramp so no stairs to climb. Inlet Beach has multiple access points 2 blocks away. There is a walkable tunnel to the beach. Alternatively, you can drive down Pinewood Lane then turn onto Orange Street, cross over 98 and your toes are in the sand!

ACCOMMODATIONS: Sleeps 13
- Bedroom 1 - 2 Twin/Twin Bunks, shared bathroom w/Shower
- Bedroom 2 - King, Ensuite w/shower
- Bedroom 3 - Queen, Ensuite w/shower
- Bedroom 4 - Queen, shared bathroom Tub/Shower
- Bedroom 5 - King, shared bathroom Tub/Shower
- Loveseat Pull Twin Bed - First Level outside Bunk Room

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Private Rooftop Terrace and Lounge with Gulf Views
• Community Pool
• Bunk Room with 2 Twin/Twin bunk beds
• Balcony on every floor
• Smart TVs plus 1 Roku
• Coffee Maker -- pods and drip
• Gas Grill
• Washer/Dryer
• Self-Check in
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes, etc
• Fully stocked kitchen

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.

Parking Details:
- This home includes 2-3 parking spaces (Guest Have Access to Garage)

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
